name: Tera Studio
description: Hosted Tera Studio MCP server for singers: find a song's key (with its relative key) and tempo in BPM, or move a song up or down by up to 6 semitones at the same speed. Both tools open a small app where the user picks the file; it is analysed or shifted in their browser and never uploaded. A third tool returns the steps and link to hear a song sung in the user's own voice on terastudio.co. Read-only, no sign-in, no API key.
author: Tera Studio
